Apple (AAPL) Holder Violich Capital Management Has Decreased Stake by $1.12 Million; As Splunk Com (SPLK) Stock Value Rose, Pinebridge Investments LP Has Increased Its Holding
June 2, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Pinebridge Investments Lp increased its stake in Splunk Inc Com (SPLK) by 78.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pinebridge Investments Lp bought 23,655 shares as the company’s stock rose 16.44% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 53,630 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.28 million, up from 29,975 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pinebridge Investments Lp who had been investing in Splunk Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.52B market cap company. The stock increased 2.83% or $3.14 during the last trading session, reaching $113.95. About 1.34 million shares traded. Splunk Inc. (NASDAQ:SPLK) has risen 64.35% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 51.78% the S&P500.
Violich Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.96% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Violich Capital Management Inc sold 6,680 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 105,402 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $17.68M, down from 112,082 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Violich Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $935.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Pinebridge Investments Lp, which manages about $38.23B and $4.22 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Nektar Therapeutics Com (NASDAQ:NKTR) by 129,034 shares to 558 shares, valued at $60,000 in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Exlservice Holdings Inc Com (NASDAQ:EXLS) by 6,250 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 5,977 shares, and cut its stake in Tjx Cos Inc New Com (NYSE:TJX).
